title: City Funds Park Pier, Cuts Water Rates
summary:
*   **Water Rates Reduced:** Approved a significant reduction in the minimum monthly water rate, lowering it from $1 for 5,000 gallons to $0.50 for 2,500 gallons, effective January 1, 1915.
*   **Municipal Park Pier Funded:** Allocated $2,500 for the construction of a new pier at the Municipal Park located by the Dam.
*   **Key Utility Upgrades:** Approved the purchase of $3,400 worth of underground electrical cables and $1,450 for new grates at the Water & Light Plant.
*   **Sewer Debt Servicing:** Authorized a $2,000 transfer to cover upcoming interest payments on the city's $80,000 debt related to the Austin Sewerage Company.

. Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin, Texas, December 17, 1914. 175 The Council
was called to order by the Mayor: Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Absent none.
The minutes of the last regular and subsequent recessed meetings were read & adopted.
Reports of City Officers:
The Mayor laid before the Council the report of the Supt of Streets and that of the Supt
of construction new City Hospital, which were read and ordered filed:

Councilman Bartholomew offered the following resolution: Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin : That the bid of the American Steel Wire Association
,presented by D O Conner, for the underground cables to be supplied according to
specifications prepared by the City Electrician ,said bid amounting to $ 3,400.00 f o b
Austin,less 1% cash in 10days on specified lengths, be accepted.
Be it further resolved by the City Council : That the prices, as detailed in the written
bid of the above association , shall be used in the purchase of additional cable should
same be desired.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Dec 19th 1914:
All present except Councilman Haynes :
The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin ,Texas: That the sum of two thousand five hundred ( $ 2,500.00)
dollars be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the General Contingent fund of the
City of Austin,Texas, to pay a partial , approved estimate of that amount made in behalf
of A A Mundt, upon his contract to build the pier in front of the Municipal Park at the
Dam. xxxxx The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,
Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Haynes 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Dec 21st 1914: All present:
The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin : That beginning January 1st 1915, the minimum rate for Water be
reduced from one dollar per month for five thousand gallons to fifty cents per month for
twenty five hundred gallons.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor
